note: Two-legged walk, feet half a cycle apart, duty above 0.5 for the double-support window that separates a walk from a run. Stride is in leg lengths (the biped wheelbase), so 0.8 is a relaxed pace. The body rises twice per cycle, over each stance leg, and the arms swing against the leg on their own side with the elbow folding a little further as each comes forward.
